description: On/off toggle switch with label, disabled state, keyboard accessibility (Space key), and ARIA switch role.

parameters.name: ValueChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the toggle state changes.

parameters.name: Label
parameters.description: Label text shown beside the toggle.

parameters.name: AriaLabel
parameters.description: Accessible name for the switch, rendered as aria-label on the inner input rather than on the wrapper. Use it when the switch must carry a name without any visible text of its own; it takes precedence over Label for the accessible name and does not render a visible span.

parameters.name: AriaLabelledBy
parameters.description: Space-separated id list of the element(s) that name the switch, rendered as aria-labelledby on the inner input. Use it when the visible label already exists elsewhere on the page and the switch itself has to stay alone inside its own element.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: Id applied to the inner input, so a host-owned <label for="…"> can point at the switch. Null (the default) renders no id attribute.

parameters.name: Required
parameters.description: Marks the switch required: aria-required="true" on the input and, when Label renders visible text, the same asterisk marker the other inputs use.
